subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “A museum played a radio broadcast from decades ago.”?
options: Students were disturbed because the mouth and voice looked real.
The sound was unclear, and the speaker's voice cracked with static.
The classroom fan made a clicking sound every time it turned.
People have always used images and sound to shape public feeling.
